description.text: Fudan University is recognized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS etc. The program is completely taught in English and follows the principle of consolidating academic basis, stressing technical skills, enhancing interdiscipline and conducting clinical pratices.Offered by Shanghai Medical College of Fudan University, this program is open to international students in pursuit of the science and practice of medicine. Those with exceptional performance will have oversea clinical internship opportunities. After completing the total required credits, students will conferred diploma by Fudan University and qualified students will receive the Bachelor of Medicine and the Bachelor Surgery (M.B.S.S.). Graduates will have the opportunity to enroll for Physician Qualification Exam according to the relative regulations of the concerned country.Teaching ObjectivesThe course aims to educate students to study basic theory and elementary knowledge in medicine, gain basic clinical skills of some common diseases diagnosis processing, have the primary treatment ability to urgent, difficult and severe symptoms, and be qualified for careers in hospitals, the medical and health units, medical science research departments as well as other organizations related medicine.Program DescriptionThe curriculum planning shall include the following three parts:(1) Chinese culture and natural science courses. In order to facilitate their learning and life in China and contact with patients in their medical practice, the Chinese language shall be a compulsory course during the whole undergraduate medical program in English for international students in China.(2) Basic medical sciences, behavioral science, humanities, social science and medical ethics, preventive medicine and clinical medicine. It is also required to pass the examinations of these courses respectively.(3) Internship. The institutions shall meticulously organize the reasonable arrangement of the internship. The duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks).Curriculum CategoryMain Course Chinese Culture Course & Natural Science Course Brief introduction to China, Chinese, Medical Chinese, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Modern Biology Science, Computer and Physical Education. Liberal Arts Course & Elementary Medicine Course Medical Psychology, Medical Ethnics, Preventive Medicine, Cell Biology, Anthropotomy, Histoembryology, Physiology, Biologic Chemistry and Molecular Biology, Immunology, Genetics, Pathogenic Biology, Pathology, Pharmacology and Morbid Physiology. Clinical Medicine Course Diagnostics, Imaging Diagnostics, Medicine, Surgery, Gynecotokology, Pediatrics, Epidemiology, Psychiatry, Neurology and Traditional Chinese Medicine. Note: Every semester's curriculums will be adjusted according to the university arrangement at that time.Internship InformationStudents can choose to do the internship/training in China, their home country or any other country.If international students would like to do the internship in China, Fudan University would help student choose a hospital.If students want to do the internship in other country, Fudan University need to do an qualification evaluation on the hospital which student choose.And, students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in Fudan University.Degree Awarded On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree byFudanUniversity,if they meet the degree regulations of FudanUniversity. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery).Career After obtaining MBBS Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council in order to get registered and practice medicine. According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Except this, one can also start his own clinic or pursue study for master's degree.

duration.text: The Data Science and Big Data Technology at Fudan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 250 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 11111 USD/per year ￥ 80000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Only ordinary passportis accepted and the expiry date should be later than September 30, 2025. 2. Applicants currently residing in China must providea copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.3. Diploma of highest degree conferred or proof of impending graduation (for applicants in their final year of study) (Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English).4. Transcripts of highest degree conferred (original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English).5. Original or notarized copy of following English language test result(only for applicants whose native language is not English), students from high school with major courses taught in English may be waivered of the English language test.6. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from whom can attest to the quality of the applicant’sacademic performance and scholastic potential. The letters must include recommenders’ phone number and email address.If the letters cannot be uploaded by the applicant, the applicant can send the link in the system to the recommender for filling in the letter. 7. Applicants who are under 18 years old by September 1, 2025must submit a Guarantee Statement, which can be downloaded from the website（https://iso.fudan.edu.cn/16062/list.htm）；The guarantor should be an adult, living in Chinese mainlandwith a stable source of income.8. Applicants in category Application Qualification 2：（1）Applicants who were born in a foreign country and have acquired foreign citizenship at birth, should provide documents to prove that one or both of the applicant’s parents have acquired permanent residence of the country before the applicant’s birth.Applicants who used to hold Chinese travel documentsor passes shouldprovide documentation of cancellation/rescissionof their Chinese citizenship.Applicants who have emigrated from Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan and have acquired foreign citizenship should also provide documentation of cancellation/rescission of theirChinese citizenship. 7(2)If the applicant has ever visited or lived in Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan, the applicant should submit entry and exit records and relevant visa or residence permit from May 1, 2021(inclusive) upon application.9. Applicants may submit additional supporting documents which may demonstrate their comprehensive abilities along with the required documents,for example, award certificates, published essays, admission notices from otheruniversities, etc.10. Statement of non-criminal record.11. Statement of personal financial capacity or financial support.If the applicant issponsored by others, please visit https://iso.fudan.edu.cn/isoenglish/16217/list.htm, download and fill in the Statement of Financial Support for International Students,and submit relevant documents

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or above, qualified for university entrance, physically and mentally healthyforeigners (applicants with color weakness and color blindness are not eligible to apply).2.According toNationality Law of the People’s Republic of Chinaand the regulations released by Ministry of Educationof the PRC[Circular No. 12 (2020)], if an applicant was born in a foreign country and one or both of the applicant’s parents hold Chinese citizenship (including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan), the applicant shall have Chinese citizenship; however, if the applicant’s parents who hold Chinese citizenship (including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) hadacquired permanent residenceof the foreign country before the applicant’s birth, the applicant shall not have Chinese citizenship.If anapplicant wants to apply as an international student, the applicant must have held 4a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality before May 1, 2021. In addition, the applicant must have lived outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least twoyears during the period between May 1, 2021and April 30, 2025(subject to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year).Emigrants from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan applying as international students must have held a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality before May 1, 2021. In addition, the applicant must have lived outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period between May 1, 2021and April 30, 2025(subject to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year).★Please pay special attention to Article 8 of the ‘Application Procedure’and prepare the required documents in advance.★Ifbothof the applicant’sparents were foreign nationals at the time of the applicant’s birth, Article 2 above does not apply
